records.literal_gloss: A psalm, a song for the day of the Sabbath.

en.L: A psalm. A song for the day of the Sabbath.
en.B: A psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.
en.R: A psalm. A song for the Sabbath.

fr.L: Un psaume. Un cantique pour le jour du sabbat.
fr.B: Un psaume. Un cantique pour le jour du sabbat.
fr.R: Un chant. Un chant pour le sabbat.

sw.L: Zaburi. Wimbo kwa ajili ya siku ya Sabato.
sw.B: Zaburi. Wimbo wa siku ya Sabato.

es.L: Salmo. Cántico para el día del sábado.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: for the Sabbath: sung on the seventh day
decisions.reason: This is the only psalm whose Hebrew title names a day. The Mishnah (Tamid 7:4) lists a psalm the Levites sang in the temple for each day of the week, with this one for the Sabbath. The psalm praises God's works (verses 5-6), fitting the day that remembers creation (Exodus 20:11).

decisions.choice: a psalm, a song
decisions.reason: Both words name a song: mizmor is a song with music (3:1), shir is the ordinary word for a song (46:1).

decisions.choice: "Zaburi" kept at Readable here, where the English Readable keeps "A psalm"
decisions.reason: The title has both a psalm and a song, and the English Readable keeps both; Swahili does the same rather than say "song" twice.

source.text: ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Good [it is] to give thanks to YHWH, and to sing praises to your name, Most High,

en.L: [It is] good to give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and to sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, Most High,
en.B: It is a good thing to thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q to sing and play in praise of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, Most High,
en.R: It is good to thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q It is good to sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, the God who is above all.

fr.L: [Il est] bon de rendre grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q et de chanter des louanges à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, Très-Haut,
fr.B: C’est une bonne chose de rendre grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q de chanter et de jouer en l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, Très-Haut,
fr.R: C’est bien de remercier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q C’est bien de chanter {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} louanges, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout.

sw.L: [Ni] vyema kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na kuliimbia sifa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee Aliye Juu Kabisa,
sw.B: Ni jambo jema kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kuimba na kupiga vinanda kulisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee Aliye Juu Kabisa,
sw.R: Ni vizuri kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Ni vizuri kukuimbia sifa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Mungu uliye juu ya wote.

es.L: Bueno [es] dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q y cantar alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, oh Altísimo,
es.B: Es bueno dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q cantar y tocar en alabanza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, Altísimo,
es.R: Es bueno dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. \q Es bueno cantarte alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, el Dios que está por encima de todo.

decisions.choice: sing praises: sing with music
decisions.reason: The verb (zamar) means to sing and play in praise (7:18), the root of mizmor, "psalm" (verse 1).

decisions.choice: your name, Most High: from speaking about God to speaking to him
decisions.reason: The first line speaks of the LORD; the second turns to address him. The sentence runs on to verse 4, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title ('Elyon) means: God above everything.

records.literal_gloss: to declare in the morning your loyal love, and your faithfulness in the nights,

en.L: to declare in the morning {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness in the nights,
en.B: to tell of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love at sunrise \q and of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness through the nights,
en.R: It is good to tell about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love every morning, \q and about how faithful {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are every night.

fr.L: d’annoncer le matin {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité pendant les nuits,
fr.B: de dire {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle au lever du jour \q et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité au long des nuits,
fr.R: C’est bien de parler de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle chaque matin, \q et de dire chaque soir combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle.

sw.L: kutangaza asubuhi upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, \q na uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} nyakati za usiku,
sw.B: kusimulia upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma jua linapochomoza \q na uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiku kucha,
sw.R: Ni vizuri kueleza juu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma kila asubuhi, \q na juu ya jinsi ulivyo mwaminifu kila usiku.

es.L: anunciar por la mañana {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad en las noches,
es.B: contar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel al salir el sol \q y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad durante las noches,
es.R: Es bueno hablar de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel cada mañana, \q y de lo fiel que eres cada noche.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: morning and nights: all the time
decisions.reason: Naming the two ends of the day means praise at every hour (55:18).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: It is good
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and repeats the opening words of verse 2.

records.literal_gloss: on [the] ten and on [the] harp, on [the] melody with [the] lyre.

en.L: on [the instrument of] ten [strings] and on [the] harp, \q with [the] melody on [the] lyre.
en.B: with the ten-stringed instrument and the harp, \q to the sounding music of the lyre.
en.R: It is good to do this with music on harps and lyres, \q and on instruments with ten strings.

fr.L: sur [l’instrument à] dix [cordes] et sur [la] harpe, \q avec [la] mélodie sur [la] lyre.
fr.B: avec l’instrument à dix cordes et la harpe, \q au son de la musique de la lyre.
fr.R: C’est bien de le faire en musique, avec des harpes et des lyres, \q et avec des instruments à dix cordes.

sw.L: kwa [kinanda cha nyuzi] kumi na kwa kinubi, \q kwa sauti tamu ya zeze.
sw.B: kwa kinanda cha nyuzi kumi na kinubi, \q kwa muziki unaovuma wa zeze.
sw.R: Ni vizuri kufanya hivyo kwa muziki wa vinubi na zeze, \q na kwa vinanda vyenye nyuzi kumi.

es.L: con [el instrumento de] diez [cuerdas] y con [el] arpa, \q con [la] melodía en [la] lira.
es.B: con el instrumento de diez cuerdas y el arpa, \q al son resonante de la lira.
es.R: Es bueno hacerlo con música de arpas y liras, \q y con instrumentos de diez cuerdas.

decisions.choice: ten-stringed instrument, harp, lyre
decisions.reason: The kinnor was a hand-held lyre and the nevel a larger stringed instrument (33:2); the "ten" ('asor) is an instrument with ten strings, or a ten-stringed harp, as in 33:2 and 144:9.

decisions.choice: melody: a resounding sound
decisions.reason: The word (higgayon) is the one left as "Higgaion" in 9:17; here it is the sound of the lyre.

decisions.choice: It is good to do this
decisions.reason: Readable makes the verse its own sentence.

decisions.choice: "kinubi" for the harp and "zeze" for the lyre
decisions.reason: Swahili has its own names for stringed instruments; "kinubi" is the harp and "zeze" a stringed instrument played by hand, which keeps the two Hebrew instruments apart.

source.text: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה בְּפָעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: For you have made me glad, YHWH, by your work; at [the] works of your hands I shout for joy.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me glad, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} work; \q at the works of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands I shout for joy.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} deeds, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, have filled me with joy; \q I sing out over all that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands have made.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done make me happy. \q I sing for joy about everything {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as réjoui, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} œuvre ; \q devant les œuvres de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains, je crie de joie.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, m’ont rempli de joie ; \q je chante devant tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains ont fait.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait me rend heureux. \q Je chante de joie pour tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait.

sw.L: Kwa maana umenifurahisha, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa kazi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q kwa kazi za mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ninapiga kelele za furaha.
sw.B: Kwa maana matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yamenijaza furaha; \q ninaimba kwa sauti juu ya yote ambayo mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imefanya.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mambo uliyoyafanya yananifurahisha. \q Ninaimba kwa furaha juu ya kila kitu ulichofanya.

es.L: Porque me has alegrado, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} obra; \q ante las obras de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos grito de júbilo.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, me han llenado de alegría; \q canto con júbilo por todo lo que han hecho {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, las cosas que has hecho me hacen feliz. \q Canto de alegría por todo lo que has hecho.

decisions.choice: your work, the works of your hands: what God has made and done
decisions.reason: The words take in creation and God's acts in history, including the judgment of the wicked in verses 8-12 (90:16; 143:5).

decisions.choice: all that your hands have made (B); everything you have done (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of hands; Readable says it plainly.

source.text: מַה־גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: How great are your works, YHWH! Exceedingly deep are your thoughts.

en.L: How great are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Exceedingly deep are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} thoughts.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how great the things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do! \q How very deep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} plans!
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do such great things! \q Your thoughts go deeper than we can understand.

fr.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres sont grandes, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! \q Très profondes sont {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pensées.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres sont grandes ! \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} desseins sont profonds !
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais de si grandes choses ! \q Tes pensées sont trop profondes pour que nous les comprenions.

sw.L: Jinsi zilivyo kuu kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Mawazo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ni ya kina kirefu mno.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mambo unayoyafanya ni makuu mno! \q Mipango {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ina kina kirefu ajabu!
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unafanya mambo makuu mno! \q Mawazo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yana kina kuliko tunavyoweza kuelewa.

es.L: ¡Qué grandes son {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! \q Muy profundos son {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pensamientos.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡qué grandes las cosas que haces! \q ¡Qué profundos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} designios!
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces cosas tan grandes! \q Tus pensamientos son más profundos de lo que podemos entender.

decisions.choice: deep thoughts: plans beyond human understanding
decisions.reason: God's thoughts are his purposes (33:11; 40:6), too deep for people to see to the bottom. Verse 7 says who does not understand them.

decisions.choice: go deeper than we can understand
decisions.reason: Readable says what "deep" means (m1).

source.text: אִֽישׁ־בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־יָבִ֥ין אֶת־זֹֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: A stupid man not knows, and a fool not understands this:

en.L: {{gender:A senseless person|A senseless man}} does not know, \q and a fool does not understand this:
en.B: Senseless people do not know it; \q fools cannot grasp this:
en.R: Foolish people do not know this. \q People without sense cannot understand it.

fr.L: {{gender:La personne stupide|L’homme stupide}} ne sait pas, \q et l’insensé ne comprend pas ceci :
fr.B: Les gens sans intelligence ne le savent pas ; \q les insensés ne peuvent comprendre ceci :
fr.R: Les gens stupides ne savent pas cela. \q Ceux qui n’ont pas de bon sens ne peuvent pas le comprendre.

sw.L: Mtu mjinga hajui, \q wala mpumbavu haelewi jambo hili:
sw.B: Watu wasio na akili hawalijui; \q wapumbavu hawawezi kulielewa hili:
sw.R: Watu wapumbavu hawajui jambo hili. \q Watu wasio na akili hawawezi kulielewa.

es.L: {{gender:La persona insensata|El hombre insensato}} no sabe, \q y el necio no entiende esto:
es.B: Los insensatos no lo saben; \q los necios no pueden comprender esto:
es.R: La gente tonta no sabe esto. \q Los que no tienen juicio no lo pueden entender.

decisions.choice: stupid: dull as an animal
decisions.reason: The word (ba'ar) describes a person no wiser than a beast (49:11; 73:22).

decisions.choice: this: what follows
decisions.reason: "This" points ahead to verse 8: the wicked flourish only to be destroyed.

decisions.choice: a senseless person (with "a senseless man" as the alternative at Literal); plurals at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The words describe anyone who will not understand, so Literal gives inclusive wording by default; Balanced and Readable use plurals.

decisions.choice: the gender setting on the noun at Literal: "La personne stupide" / "L'homme stupide"
decisions.reason: As the English: the Hebrew ʾish means anyone here. The adjective agrees with its noun, so it goes inside the span.

source.text: בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים׀כְּמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: When [the] wicked sprout like grass and all [the] doers of wickedness flourish, [it is] for them to be destroyed forever.

en.L: when [the] wicked sprout like grass, \q and all who do wickedness flourish, \q [it is] that they may be destroyed forever.
en.B: though the wicked shoot up like green plants \q and all who do wrong are in bloom, \q it is only so that they may be destroyed for all time.
en.R: Wicked people may spring up like grass. \q Everyone who does evil may seem to do well. \q But they will be destroyed forever.

fr.L: quand [les] méchants germent comme l’herbe, \q et que fleurissent tous ceux qui font le mal, \q [c’est] pour être détruits pour toujours.
fr.B: même si les méchants poussent comme de l’herbe verte \q et que tous ceux qui font le mal sont en fleurs, \q ce n’est que pour être détruits à jamais.
fr.R: Les méchants peuvent pousser comme de l’herbe. \q Ceux qui font le mal peuvent avoir l’air de bien réussir. \q Mais ils seront détruits pour toujours.

sw.L: waovu wanapochipuka kama majani, \q na watenda maovu wote wanapostawi, \q [ni] ili waangamizwe milele.
sw.B: ingawa waovu wanaota kama mimea mibichi \q na watenda maovu wote wanachanua, \q ni ili tu waangamizwe milele.
sw.R: Waovu wanaweza kuota kama majani. \q Kila mtenda maovu anaweza kuonekana anafanikiwa. \q Lakini wataangamizwa milele.

es.L: que cuando [los] malvados brotan como la hierba, \q y florecen todos los que hacen maldad, \q [es] para ser destruidos para siempre.
es.B: aunque los malvados broten como plantas verdes \q y todos los que hacen el mal estén en flor, \q es solo para que sean destruidos para siempre.
es.R: Los malvados pueden brotar como la hierba. \q Todos los que hacen el mal pueden parecer que les va bien. \q Pero serán destruidos para siempre.

decisions.choice: like grass: quick to grow and quick to wither
decisions.reason: As in 37:2 and 90:5-6, grass springs up fast and dries up in a day; the righteous are like trees (verses 13-15).

decisions.choice: to be destroyed: their end
decisions.reason: The form says what their flourishing leads to: it ends in destruction for good.

records.literal_gloss: But you [are] on high forever, YHWH.

en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q are enthroned on high for all time.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q will rule from heaven forever.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] en haut \q pour toujours, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sièges sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône là-haut pour toujours.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} régneras du haut du ciel pour toujours.

sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q utatawala kutoka mbinguni milele.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [estás] en lo alto \q para siempre, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q reinas en lo alto por todos los tiempos.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q gobernarás desde el cielo para siempre.

decisions.choice: the center of the psalm
decisions.reason: This short line stands at the center of the psalm, with seven lines before it and seven after: the LORD above all, against the wicked who perish.

decisions.choice: on high: in the height, the place of God's throne
decisions.reason: The word (marom) is the height of heaven, where God reigns (7:8; 93:4).

decisions.choice: enthroned on high (B); rule from heaven (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what being on high means (m2).

source.text: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ׀יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, your enemies, YHWH, for look, your enemies will perish; all [the] doers of wickedness will be scattered.

en.L: For look, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q for look, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies will perish; \q all who do wickedness will be scattered.
en.B: Look at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Look, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies are doomed; \q everyone who does evil will be driven apart.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies will surely die. \q Everyone who does evil will be scattered.

fr.L: Car voici, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q car voici, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis périront ; \q tous ceux qui font le mal seront dispersés.
fr.B: Regarde {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! \q Oui, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis vont à leur perte ; \q tous ceux qui font le mal seront chassés de tous côtés.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis vont mourir, c’est sûr. \q Tous ceux qui font le mal seront dispersés.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa maana tazama, adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} wataangamia; \q watenda maovu wote watatawanyika.
sw.B: Tazama adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Tazama, adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} wataangamia; \q kila atendaye maovu atafukuzwa huku na huku.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hakika adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} watakufa. \q Kila atendaye maovu atatawanyika.

es.L: Porque he aquí {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q porque he aquí, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos perecerán; \q serán dispersados todos los que hacen maldad.
es.B: ¡Mira a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! \q Mira, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos están perdidos; \q todos los que hacen el mal serán dispersados.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos de seguro morirán. \q Todos los que hacen el mal serán dispersados.

decisions.choice: the repeated line: rising emphasis
decisions.reason: The line starts, breaks off, and starts again, adding a word each time, a pattern of Hebrew poetry (93:3; 94:3).

decisions.choice: scattered: broken up like a defeated army
decisions.reason: The verb (parad) is used of a group separated and scattered (Job 4:11).

source.text: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And you have raised like a wild ox my horn; I have been anointed with fresh oil.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have raised my horn like [that of] a wild ox; \q I have been anointed with fresh oil.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me strong like a wild ox; \q fresh oil has been poured over me.
en.R: You have made me as strong as a wild ox. \q You have poured fresh oil on me to honor me.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as élevé ma corne comme [celle d’]un buffle ; \q j’ai été oint d’une huile fraîche.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as rendu fort comme un buffle ; \q une huile fraîche a été versée sur moi.
fr.R: Tu m’as rendu aussi fort qu’un buffle. \q Tu as versé sur moi de l’huile fraîche pour m’honorer.

sw.L: Lakini umeiinua pembe yangu kama [ya] nyati; \q nimepakwa mafuta mapya.
sw.B: Lakini umenifanya kuwa na nguvu kama nyati; \q mafuta mapya yamemiminwa juu yangu.
sw.R: Umenifanya kuwa na nguvu kama nyati. \q Umenimiminia mafuta mapya kunipa heshima.

es.L: Pero has levantado mi cuerno como [el del] búfalo; \q he sido ungido con aceite fresco.
es.B: Pero me has hecho fuerte como un búfalo; \q se ha derramado sobre mí aceite fresco.
es.R: Me has hecho tan fuerte como un búfalo. \q Has derramado aceite fresco sobre mí para honrarme.

decisions.choice: raised my horn: made me strong and victorious
decisions.reason: A horn is a picture of an animal's strength, and raising it means victory and honor (75:11; 89:18; 1 Samuel 2:1).

decisions.choice: I have been anointed: soaked with oil
alternatives: my old age (is) with fresh oil
decisions.reason: The verb (balal) means to moisten or mix with oil. Oil on the head was a sign of honor and joy (23:5). The ancient Greek translation reads the word as "my old age".

decisions.choice: You have poured; to honor me
decisions.reason: Readable names who acts and what the oil means (m2).

source.text: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And my eye has looked on my watchers; on [those who] rise against me, evildoers, my ears have heard.

en.L: And my eye has looked on those who watch for me; \q of those who rise against me, evildoers, my ears have heard.
en.B: My eyes have looked in triumph on those who lay in wait for me; \q my ears have heard what became of the evildoers who rose up against me.
en.R: I have seen my enemies defeated. \q I have heard about the end of the evil people who attacked me.

fr.L: Et mon œil a regardé ceux qui me guettent ; \q de ceux qui se lèvent contre moi, des malfaiteurs, mes oreilles ont entendu.
fr.B: Mes yeux ont vu, triomphants, ceux qui me guettaient ; \q mes oreilles ont appris ce qui est arrivé aux malfaiteurs qui se dressaient contre moi.
fr.R: J’ai vu mes ennemis vaincus. \q J’ai entendu parler de la fin des gens mauvais qui m’attaquaient.

sw.L: Na jicho langu limewatazama wanaonivizia; \q juu ya wale wanaoniinukia, watenda mabaya, masikio yangu yamesikia.
sw.B: Macho yangu yamewatazama kwa ushindi wale walioniotea; \q masikio yangu yamesikia yaliyowapata watenda maovu walioniinukia.
sw.R: Nimewaona adui zangu wakishindwa. \q Nimesikia habari za mwisho wa watu waovu walionishambulia.

es.L: Y mi ojo ha mirado a los que me acechan; \q de los que se levantan contra mí, malhechores, han oído mis oídos.
es.B: Mis ojos han visto con triunfo a los que me acechaban; \q mis oídos han oído lo que les pasó a los malhechores que se alzaron contra mí.
es.R: He visto a mis enemigos derrotados. \q He oído del fin de la gente malvada que me atacó.

decisions.choice: my watchers: enemies lying in wait
decisions.reason: The word (shur) is taken as the one in 5:9 and 27:11, those who watch closely for a chance to attack. A word spelled the same way means "wall".

decisions.choice: look on: look on in triumph
decisions.reason: To look on enemies is to see them defeated (54:9; 118:7). The Hebrew does not say what was seen or heard; the sense is their downfall.

decisions.choice: in triumph, what became of (B); defeated, the end of (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what was seen and heard (m2).

source.text: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] righteous like the palm tree will flourish; like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow.

en.L: [The] righteous like the palm tree will flourish; \q like a cedar in Lebanon {{gender:they|he}} will grow.
en.B: The righteous will thrive like the palm tree \q and rise tall as a cedar on Lebanon.
en.R: People who do what is right will grow strong like palm trees. \q They will grow tall like the cedar trees in Lebanon.

fr.L: [Le] juste comme le palmier fleurira ; \q comme un cèdre du Liban il grandira.
fr.B: Le juste prospérera comme le palmier \q et s’élèvera comme un cèdre du Liban.
fr.R: Ceux qui font ce qui est juste deviendront forts comme des palmiers. \q Ils deviendront grands comme les cèdres du Liban.

sw.L: Mwenye haki atastawi kama mtende; \q atakua kama mwerezi katika Lebanoni.
sw.B: Wenye haki watasitawi kama mtende \q na kuinuka warefu kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni.
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda haki watakua na nguvu kama mitende. \q Watakua warefu kama mierezi ya Lebanoni.

es.L: [El] justo florecerá como la palmera; \q crecerá como un cedro en el Líbano.
es.B: El justo florecerá como la palmera \q y se alzará como un cedro del Líbano.
es.R: Los que hacen lo que es justo crecerán fuertes como las palmeras. \q Crecerán altos como los cedros del Líbano.

decisions.choice: palm and cedar: green, tall and long-lived
decisions.reason: The date palm stays green in dry land and bears fruit for many years; the cedars of Lebanon were the tallest and strongest trees known (Isaiah 2:13; Ezekiel 31:3). They stand against the grass of verse 8.

decisions.choice: the righteous: those who live rightly before God
decisions.reason: The word (tsaddiq) is singular, standing for every such person (1:6).

decisions.choice: they (with "he" as the alternative at Literal)
decisions.reason: "The righteous" stands for anyone who lives this way (m2), so Literal gives "they" by default; Balanced and Readable need no pronoun or use the plural.

decisions.choice: "il" for the righteous at Literal, with no gender setting
alternatives: a span on the pronoun, as the English "they|he"
decisions.reason: French puts the gender setting on nouns only; "le juste ... il" is ordinary generic French and means anyone who is righteous.

decisions.choice: el justo ... crecerá, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "they" with "he" as the alternative. In Spanish "el justo" and its verb already take in any person who lives rightly, so Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew singular with no setting.

source.text: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Planted in [the] house of YHWH, in [the] courts of our God they will flourish.

en.L: Planted in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q in the courts of our God they will flourish.
en.B: Rooted in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house, \q they will bloom in the courtyards of our God.
en.R: They are like trees planted at the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q They grow strong in the courtyards of our God's temple.

fr.L: Plantés dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q dans les parvis de notre Dieu ils fleuriront.
fr.B: Enracinés dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q ils fleuriront dans les parvis de notre Dieu.
fr.R: Ils sont comme des arbres plantés près de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Ils deviennent forts dans les cours du temple de notre Dieu.

sw.L: Wamepandwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q katika nyua za Mungu wetu watastawi.
sw.B: Wakiwa na mizizi katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q watachanua katika nyua za Mungu wetu.
sw.R: Wao ni kama miti iliyopandwa nyumbani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Wanakua na nguvu katika viwanja vya hekalu la Mungu wetu.

es.L: Plantados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q en los atrios de nuestro Dios florecerán.
es.B: Arraigados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q florecerán en los atrios de nuestro Dios.
es.R: Son como árboles plantados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Crecen fuertes en los patios del templo de nuestro Dios.

decisions.choice: planted in the house of the LORD: living near God
decisions.reason: Trees in the temple courts are a picture of those who live close to God and draw life from him (52:10; 1:3).

decisions.choice: They are like trees
decisions.reason: Readable makes the comparison clear.

source.text: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Still they will bear fruit in old age; full of sap and fresh they will be,

en.L: Still they will bear fruit in old age; \q full of sap and fresh they will be,
en.B: Even when they are old they will still bear fruit; \q they will stay rich with sap and green,
en.R: Even when they are old, they will still produce fruit. \q They will stay healthy and strong.

fr.L: Encore ils porteront du fruit dans la vieillesse ; \q pleins de sève et verts ils seront,
fr.B: Même vieux, ils porteront encore du fruit ; \q ils resteront pleins de sève et verdoyants,
fr.R: Même quand ils seront vieux, ils donneront encore des fruits. \q Ils resteront en bonne santé et forts.

sw.L: Bado watazaa matunda katika uzee; \q watakuwa wamejaa utomvu na wabichi,
sw.B: Hata wakiwa wazee bado watazaa matunda; \q watabaki wamejaa utomvu na wabichi,
sw.R: Hata wakiwa wazee, bado watazaa matunda. \q Watabaki wazima na wenye nguvu.

es.L: Aún darán fruto en la vejez; \q llenos de savia y frondosos estarán,
es.B: Aun cuando sean viejos seguirán dando fruto; \q se mantendrán llenos de savia y verdes,
es.R: Aun cuando sean viejos, seguirán dando fruto. \q Se mantendrán sanos y fuertes.

decisions.choice: full of sap and fresh: healthy and vigorous
decisions.reason: The first word (dashen) means fat, rich, and so thriving; the second (ra'anan) is green and fresh, the word used of the oil in verse 11.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The thought continues in verse 16, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: healthy and strong
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

source.text: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־עַוְלָ֥תָה בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: to declare that upright [is] YHWH, my rock, and there is no injustice in him.

en.L: to declare that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] upright — \q my rock, and there is no injustice in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: bearing witness that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is just: \q my rock, in whom nothing is crooked.
en.R: Their lives will show that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is fair. \q He is my rock, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} never does anything wrong.

fr.L: pour annoncer que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] droit — \q mon rocher, et il n’y a pas d’injustice en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: témoignant que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est juste : \q mon rocher, en qui rien n’est tordu.
fr.R: Leur vie montrera que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est juste. \q Il est mon rocher, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne fait jamais rien de mal.

sw.L: ili kutangaza kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mnyofu, \q mwamba wangu, wala hakuna uovu ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: wakishuhudia kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwenye haki: \q mwamba wangu, ambaye hakuna upotovu wowote ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Maisha yao yataonyesha kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwenye haki. \q Yeye ni mwamba wangu, wala hafanyi kamwe jambo lolote baya.

es.L: para anunciar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] recto: \q mi roca, y no hay injusticia en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: dando testimonio de que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es justo: \q mi roca, en quien no hay nada torcido.
es.R: Su vida mostrará que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es justo. \q Él es mi roca, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nunca hace nada malo.

decisions.choice: upright, rock, no injustice: the song of Moses
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 32:4 uses the same words of God: "the Rock ... a God of faithfulness and without injustice, righteous and upright is he".

decisions.choice: my rock: a safe, unshakable place
decisions.reason: As in 18:3, a rock is a place of safety and strength.

decisions.choice: Their lives will show
decisions.reason: Readable says how the flourishing righteous declare it: by what their lives show.
